curl.description: Transfer data from or to a server, using one of the supported protocols (HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, etc.).

fields.label: Headers
fields.tooltip: e.g., Content-Type: application/json

fields.label: Data
fields.tooltip: e.g., key=value or {"key":"value"}

fields.label: Output to file
fields.tooltip: Save response to file instead of stdout (e.g., page.html).

fields.label: Silent mode (-s)
fields.tooltip: Don't show progress or error info.

fields.label: Include headers (-i)
fields.tooltip: Include HTTP headers in output.

fields.label: URL
fields.tooltip: The target URL (e.g., https://example.com).

dig.description: DNS lookup utility. Query Domain Name System servers.

fields.label: Query Type
fields.tooltip: A (IPv4), AAAA (IPv6), MX (mail), etc.

fields.label: DNS Server
fields.tooltip: e.g., 8.8.8.8 to use Google DNS.

fields.label: Domain Name
fields.tooltip: The domain name to query, e.g., google.com

ifconfig.description: Configure network interface parameters (older tool, may need sudo).

fields.label: Interface
fields.tooltip: Network interface name (e.g., eth0, wlan0). Leave blank to show all.

ip.description: Show/manipulate routing, network devices, interfaces. Modern replacement for ifconfig.

fields.label: Subcommand
fields.tooltip: Common ip commands (e.g., 'addr show', 'link set').

netstat.description: Print network connections, routing tables, interface statistics, etc.

fields.label: Show PIDs/Program names (-p)
fields.tooltip: Requires sudo to see all program names.

fields.label: Continuous mode (-c)
fields.tooltip: Update display every second.

nmap.description: Network exploration tool and security/port scanner.

fields.label: Scan Type
fields.tooltip: Type of scan to perform. SYN scan requires sudo.

fields.label: Ports
fields.tooltip: e.g., 80,443 or 1-1024. Leave blank for default scan.

fields.label: Aggressive Scan (-A)
fields.tooltip: Enables OS detection, version detection, script scanning, and traceroute.

fields.label: Fast scan (-F)
fields.tooltip: Scan fewer ports than default.

fields.label: Output to file
fields.tooltip: Saves output in normal format to the specified file.

fields.label: Target
fields.tooltip: IP, hostname, or network range (e.g., 192.168.1.1/24).

ping.description: Send ICMP ECHO_REQUEST packets to network hosts to check connectivity.

fields.label: Count
fields.tooltip: Stop after sending this many packets (e.g., 4).

fields.label: Interval (seconds)
fields.tooltip: Wait interval seconds between packets (e.g., 0.5). Default is 1.

fields.label: Packet size
fields.tooltip: Packet size in bytes (e.g., 1024). Default is 56.

fields.label: Hostname or IP Address
fields.tooltip: e.g., google.com or 8.8.8.8

rsync.description: Fast, versatile file copying tool for local and remote copies. Better than cp/scp for syncing.

fields.label: Archive mode (-a)
fields.tooltip: Archive mode (preserves permissions, timestamps, etc.).

fields.label: Compress (-z)
fields.tooltip: Compress data during transfer.

fields.label: Delete at destination (--delete)
fields.tooltip: Delete files that don't exist on source.

fields.label: Dry run (-n)
fields.tooltip: Show what would be transferred without doing it.

fields.label: Source
fields.tooltip: Source file/directory. Can be remote user@host:/path

fields.label: Destination
fields.tooltip: Destination path. Can be remote user@host:/path

scp.description: Secure copy (remote file copy program). Copy files between hosts over SSH.

fields.label: Port
fields.tooltip: SSH port (note: capital P for scp). e.g., 2222

fields.label: Identity file
fields.tooltip: e.g., ~/.ssh/id_rsa

fields.label: Recursive (-r)
fields.tooltip: Copy directories recursively.

fields.label: Source
fields.tooltip: user@host:/path/file or local file.

fields.label: Destination
fields.tooltip: user@host:/path/ or local path.

ss.description: Socket statistics. Modern replacement for netstat with better performance.

fields.label: Show processes (-p)
fields.tooltip: Requires sudo to see all process names.

fields.label: Port
fields.tooltip: SSH port (e.g., 22). Default is 22.

fields.label: Identity file (private key)
fields.tooltip: e.g., ~/.ssh/id_rsa

fields.label: User@Hostname
fields.tooltip: e.g., root@192.168.1.1 or user@example.com

fields.label: Execute command
fields.tooltip: Command to run on remote host (e.g., ls -l).

traceroute.description: Print the route packets take to a network host.

fields.label: Max hops
fields.tooltip: Maximum number of hops (e.g., 15). Default is 30.

fields.label: Hostname or IP
fields.tooltip: Destination to trace route to (e.g., google.com).

wget.description: Non-interactive network downloader. Great for downloading files from the web.

fields.label: Output filename
fields.tooltip: Save as this filename (e.g., file.zip). Conflicts with Recursive.

fields.label: Continue download (-c)
fields.tooltip: Resume partial download.

fields.label: Recursive (-r)
fields.tooltip: Download recursively. Conflicts with Output filename.

fields.label: URL
fields.tooltip: URL of the file to download.

whois.description: Client for the WHOIS directory service. Looks up records for domain names and IP addresses.

fields.label: Domain or IP
fields.tooltip: e.g., google.com or 216.58.194.174

nc (netcat).description: The 'Swiss-army knife' for networking. Used for ports, shells, and data transfer.

fields.label: Listen Mode (-l)
fields.tooltip:
Listen for incoming connections (create a server).
Conflicts with 'Host'.

fields.label: Verbose (-v)
fields.tooltip: Show verbose output.

fields.label: Numeric IPs (-n)
fields.tooltip: Don't resolve hostnames (faster).

fields.label: Execute Program (-e)
fields.tooltip:
Execute a program on connect (e.g., /bin/bash). **DANGEROUS**
Only use in Listen Mode. Conflicts with 'Host'.

fields.label: Host (for Connect)
fields.tooltip:
The target host to connect to (e.g., 10.10.10.1).
Conflicts with 'Listen Mode' and 'Execute Program'.

fields.label: Port (Connect/Listen)
fields.tooltip:
The target port to connect to OR the port to listen on (e.g., 4444).
HTB Tip: Use 'sudo' if listening on ports < 1024.

python3 -m http.server.description: Start a simple Python web server to serve files from the current directory.

fields.label: Port
fields.tooltip:
Port to serve on (e.g., 8000). Default is 8000.
Use 'sudo' to bind to privileged ports (e.g., 80).

fields.label: Bind to IP
fields.tooltip: IP to bind to (e.g., 0.0.0.0 to listen on all interfaces).

fields.label: Directory
fields.tooltip:
Directory to serve. Default is the current directory.

HTB Tip:
This is the #1 way to serve exploits or scripts (like linpeas.sh) to a victim machine.

smbclient.description: Client for enumerating and connecting to Samba (Windows/Linux) file shares.

fields.label: List Shares (-L)
fields.tooltip:
List all available shares on the target host.
Conflicts with 'Share Name'.

fields.label: No Password (-N)
fields.tooltip: Log in with no password (anonymous login).

fields.label: Username
fields.tooltip: e.g., administrator

fields.label: Host
fields.tooltip: The target host (e.g., //10.10.10.1).

fields.label: Share Name
fields.tooltip:
The share to connect to (e.g., C$ or IPC$).
Conflicts with 'List Shares'.

HTB Tip:
Always start with `smbclient -L //HOST -N` to check for anonymous share access.
